title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.1 Sol, says it nearly matches GPT-6 Astra and costs less
description: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Sol, an upgrade focused on agentic coding, computer use and professional work. It approaches GPT-6 Astra's performance at a fifth of the standard token price. It is available to Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex.

title: DevDay 2026 Recap
description: OpenAI summarized its DevDay 2026 announcements across ChatGPT, Codex and its models. Highlights include agents for ongoing work, synced Work tasks across devices, and a beta Marketplace letting enterprises apply OpenAI commitments to partner software.

title: OpenAI launches Dots, its bubbly agentic avatar
description: OpenAI announced Dots, an always-on personal agentic assistant powered by GPT-6 Astra. It keeps working on a user's behalf between conversations. It is rolling out in ChatGPT to Pro and Business Premium users in eligible markets.

title: Barclays scales Claude to upgrade operations and improve client experience
description: Anthropic announced that Barclays is scaling Claude across the bank to upgrade operations and improve client experience. The deployment is a large-scale enterprise adoption example in financial services.

title: Armadin nabs $255.5M to detect vulnerabilities with AI agent swarms
description: Cybersecurity startup Armadin raised $255.5 million in a Series B at a valuation above $2.5 billion, co-led by Andreessen Horowitz and Accel. Its platform uses swarms of AI agents to find weaknesses in company infrastructure.

title: Salesforce to acquire AI customer research startup Listen Labs in reported $2B deal
description: Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Listen Labs, which builds AI agents that recruit, interview and analyze customers for research. The deal is reportedly worth about $2 billion.

title: Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot
description: Microsoft relaunched Copilot as a unified app with Home, Code and Autopilot, a persistent proactive agent. It also introduced Copilot Managed Runtime for running code inside a company's Microsoft 365 environment, rolling out via the Frontier program.
